ctbids-49316-5732198.description:
A charming collection of vintage and antique-style vanity, boudoir, and handbag accessories, featuring decorative mirrors, elegant compacts, and beautifully detailed personal accessories. This eclectic assortment captures the glamour of dressing tables and fashionable handbags from years gone by.
Highlights include:
Tiffany Sterling Silver Vanity Mirror: Vintage engraved sterling silver mirror with Tiffany markings, featuring ornate detailing and a decorative handle. A particularly noteworthy piece for collectors of antique silver and fine vanity accessories.  See pictures for details.
Decorative Hand Mirror: Elegant handheld mirror with an ornate gold-tone frame and pale green handle, possibly stone or glass.
Vintage Vanity Mirrors: Two additional silver-tone handheld mirrors featuring decorative handles and floral-inspired details.
Decorative Compacts: An assortment of round and rectangular cases featuring a sparkling rhinestone bow, floral porcelain-style decoration, a colorful pastoral scene, and a portrait of a Victorian-era lady.
Vintage Folding Comb: Ornately decorated metal case containing a folding comb with a tortoiseshell-style appearance.
An appealing assortment for collectors of vintage vanity accessories, decorative silver, and nostalgic personal treasures. These charming pieces evoke the elegance of an old-fashioned dressing table and offer delightful possibilities for holiday gifting or decorative display.
Condition: Assorted vintage pre-owned condition with visible scratches, tarnish, discoloration, and age-related wear. Mirror surfaces show spotting and scratches. Some cases and accessories may have worn mechanisms or interior surfaces.
Sterling Silver: The Tiffany-attributed vanity mirror is described as sterling silver; hallmark and metal content have not been independently verified. The sterling silver component has not been weighed.
